statusDetail: Audit stopped during recon as required because A Cloudflare managed challenge returned the interstitial title “Just a moment…”, robots noindex,nofollow, and HTTP 403 to the crawler; it did not resolve after a 15-second browser wait, so the target site content, templates, and flows were inaccessible. No representative listing, detail, search, form, account, or commercial flow could be discovered or exercised.

page.notes: Only the Cloudflare challenge page was observable; no claim is made about the origin application.

HAR of the blocked navigation; response breakdown includes three 403 responses.

Crawler view blocked by the challenge.
